ANA.name: Troy Terry
ANA.comment: Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.

ANA.name: Pavel Mintyukov
ANA.comment: Mintyukov (lower body) was put on injured reserve Thursday.

ANA.name: Ryan Poehling
ANA.comment: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

ANA.name: Ian Moore
ANA.comment: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.

BUF.name: Conor Timmins
BUF.comment: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

BUF.name: Matt Grzelcyk
BUF.comment: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

BUF.name: Jiri Kulich
BUF.comment: Kulich has been placed in concussion protocol, per Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Monday.

BUF.name: Alex Lyon
BUF.comment: Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.

CGY.name: Mikael Backlund
CGY.comment: Backlund (upper body) will be a game-time decision against Toronto on Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.

CGY.name: Jonathan Huberdeau
CGY.comment: Huberdeau (hip) skated with his teammates Saturday, but he isn't close to returning, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

CAR.name: Alexander Nikishin
CAR.comment: Nikishin (not injury related) will need some time before he makes his 2026-27 debut, according to Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal on Monday.

CAR.name: Mark Jankowski
CAR.comment: Jankowski (lower body) won't play against Boston on Tuesday, per Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News.

DAL.name: Matt Duchene
DAL.comment: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

DAL.name: Oskar Back
DAL.comment: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.

DET.name: Simon Edvinsson
DET.comment: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

DET.name: Marco Kasper
DET.comment: Kasper (upper body) has been given a week-to-week timetable for return.

EDM.name: Mattias Ekholm
EDM.comment: Ekholm (undisclosed) will miss at least a week after getting injured versus the Hurricanes on Thursday, Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton reports.

EDM.name: Devon Levi
EDM.comment: Levi (undisclosed) is expected to miss a few weeks, per Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton.

EDM.name: Matt Savoie
EDM.comment: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

EDM.name: Alec Regula
EDM.comment: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

EDM.name: Frederik Andersen
EDM.comment: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

EDM.name: Mattias Janmark
EDM.comment: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

FLA.name: Aleksander Barkov
FLA.comment: Barkov (lower body) will be out for approximately 6-8 weeks, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports Tuesday.

FLA.name: Jonah Gadjovich
FLA.comment: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

LAK.name: Jan Jenik
LAK.comment: Jenik (undisclosed) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by Los Angeles on Thursday, per Zach Dooley of LA Kings Insider.

LAK.name: Kevin Fiala
LAK.comment: Fiala (lower leg fracture) is at least three weeks away from being ready to play, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

MIN.name: Brock Faber
MIN.comment: Faber underwent a procedure to repair his fractured skull and is without a timetable to return, per Michael Russo of The Athletic.

MIN.name: Filip Gustavsson
MIN.comment: Head coach John Hynes said Sunday that Gustavsson (hip) is slated to miss at least another month, Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News reports.

MTL.name: Ivan Demidov
MTL.comment: Demidov (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Canadiens on Tuesday, per the NHL media site.

NJD.name: Connor Hellebuyck
NJD.comment: Head coach Sheldon Keefe said Monday that Hellebuyck (not injury related) intends to play during the Devils' upcoming three-game road trip, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.

NJD.name: Seamus Casey
NJD.comment: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.

NYI.name: Mathew Barzal
NYI.comment: Barzal (knee) will not join the Islanders for their two-game road trip, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Thursday.

NYI.name: Matias Maccelli
NYI.comment: Maccelli (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

NYR.name: Igor Shesterkin
NYR.comment: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

NYR.name: Joe Veleno
NYR.comment: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

NYR.name: Joonas Korpisalo
NYR.comment: Korpisalo (lower body) will miss at least four more weeks, per Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet on Saturday.

OTT.name: Linus Ullmark
OTT.comment: Ullmark (lower body) is expected to miss the next 1-2 weeks, Claire Hanna of TSN reports Thursday.

OTT.name: William Eklund
OTT.comment: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

PHI.name: Cam York
PHI.comment: Head coach Rick Tocchet said Friday that he isn't sure whether York (upper body) will be able to suit up Saturday against the Ducks, Jordan Hall of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

PHI.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
PHI.comment: The Flyers announced Monday that Ristolainen is expected to miss approximately two weeks due to an upper-body injury.

PHI.name: Travis Konecny
PHI.comment: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

PHI.name: Owen Tippett
PHI.comment: Tippett (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

PHI.name: Nikita Grebenkin
PHI.comment: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

PIT.name: Samuel Girard
PIT.comment: Girard (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

PIT.name: Bryan Rust
PIT.comment: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

PIT.name: Ben Kindel
PIT.comment: Kindel (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

PIT.name: Ryan Graves
PIT.comment: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

PIT.name: Justin Brazeau
PIT.comment: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

SJS.name: Igor Chernyshov
SJS.comment: Chernyshov (upper body) is week-to-week, per Sheng Peng of San Jose Hockey Now on Saturday.

SJS.name: Quentin Musty
SJS.comment: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

SJS.name: Kyle Keyser
SJS.comment: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

SEA.name: Jared McCann
SEA.comment: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

SEA.name: Ryan Lindgren
SEA.comment: Lindgren (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Kraken on Thursday and is expected to miss four to six weeks.

SEA.name: Jacob Melanson
SEA.comment: Melanson's upper-body injury was diagnosed Saturday as an anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm. He will continue to be evaluated and is out indefinitely.

SEA.name: Jake O'Brien
SEA.comment: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.

STL.name: Tyler Tucker
STL.comment: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

STL.name: Torey Krug
STL.comment: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

TBL.name: Yanni Gourde
TBL.comment: Gourde (hip) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

TOR.name: Chris Tanev
TOR.comment: The Maple Leafs announced Thursday that Tanev (lower body) is considered week-to-week, Mark Masters of TSN reports.

TOR.name: Max Domi
TOR.comment: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

TOR.name: Nick Blankenburg
TOR.comment: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

TOR.name: Dakota Joshua
TOR.comment: Joshua (abdomen) was sent to AHL Toronto on Friday for a conditioning stint.

TOR.name: Elvis Merzlikins
TOR.comment: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

UTA.name: Michael Carcone
UTA.comment: Carcone (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Mammoth on Tuesday.

VAN.name: Thatcher Demko
VAN.comment: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

WSH.name: Rasmus Sandin
WSH.comment: Sandin (knee) was placed on long-term injured reserve Monday.

WSH.name: Logan Thompson
WSH.comment: Thompson (lower body) participated in Monday's practice and remains day-to-day ahead of Wednesday's home matchup against Philadelphia, per Sammi Silber of The District Standard.

WPG.name: Josh Morrissey
WPG.comment: Morrissey (wrist) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

WPG.name: Nick Bjugstad
WPG.comment: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
